caption: Side hustle waarvan ik wou dat ik ’m eerder kende, part one. Gordel om, want deze kan je serieus veel geld opleveren. Dit is zo’n model dat je één keer opzet en daarna bijna kunt vergeten – puur passief inkomen. ​ ✅ Stap 1: Etsy Ga naar etsy.com en zoek op ‘t‑shirts’. Check de designs die rond de 11,99 verkocht worden en al tienduizenden keren zijn besteld. Zo zie je wat al geld print. ​ ✅ Stap 2: Canva Ga naar canva.com en maak een gratis account. Maak een super simpel design (tekst of graphic), net zoals in de video. Klaar? Rechtsboven op ‘delen’ → ‘downloaden’ en sla je design op. ​ ✅ Stap 3: Printify Ga naar printify.com en maak ook daar een gratis account. Kies een t‑shirt, upload je design en plaats ’m op het shirt. Dit wordt je product. ​ ✅ Stap 4: Etsy listing Ga terug naar Etsy, maak een gratis account aan en zet een listing online zoals het voorbeeld in de video. Vanaf nu: elke keer dat iemand bestelt, regelt Printify printen, verzenden en fulfilment voor je. Jij hoeft ’t niet meer aan te raken. ​ Daarom is dit één van de chillste manieren om online passief inkomen te bouwen: jij bedenkt alleen de designs en het is gratis om te starten. ​ Ik ben Jesse Riksten, high ticket sales coach. Wil je meer tips over ondernemen, geld en vrijheid? Volg me dan zodat je de volgende niet mist. ​

caption: La bourse est une illusion de sécurité bien emballée. Investir dans des ETF, c’est bien mais ne crois pas que ça fera de toi une personne libre. Parce qu’en réalité, tu confies ton avenir à un système que tu ne maîtrises pas. Les marchés, les crises, les décisions politiques… tout ça, c’est hors de ton contrôle. Ta vraie richesse, elle est pas dans un portefeuille d’actions. Elle est dans ce que tu construis, ce que tu apprends, ce que tu oses faire.  👉 Tu veux un actif rentable ? Regarde dans le miroir. #bourse #etf #riche #investissement #budget

caption: 💰 C’est quoi un ETF et pourquoi tout le monde en parle ? 📈 Un ETF (Exchange Traded Fund) est un panier d’actions qui permet d’investir dans plusieurs entreprises en même temps, sans prendre trop de risques. 📊 Exemples d’ETF connus : ✔️ SPY (S&P 500) → Investit dans les 500 plus grandes entreprises américaines. ✔️ Nasdaq-100 (QQQ) → Regroupe les 100 plus grandes entreprises tech comme Apple, Amazon et Google. ✔️ MSCI World (IWDA) → Permet d’investir dans les meilleures entreprises du monde entier. ✅ Pourquoi investir dans un ETF ? 	•	Moins de risques : Si une entreprise chute, les autres compensent. 	•	Diversification automatique : Tu n’as pas besoin de choisir toi-même les actions. 	•	Bonne rentabilité sur le long terme : Le S&P 500 a généré en moyenne 8 à 10% par an depuis 50 ans. 🚀 Tu connaissais cette stratégie d’investissement ? Dis-moi en commentaire ! 📩 Abonne-toi pour plus de conseils sur l’investissement et la finance ! 💰📈 #bourse #investissement #finance #business #revenupassif #educationfinanciere

Recently, he has been focusing on Ethereum's long-term resilience and privacy needs ? Buterin has shifted his focus from scaling to protocol hardening and decentralized acceleration (d/acc) technology. He aims to achieve single-slot finality, statelessness, and virtual machine longevity. Buterin has also proposed a Layer-Zero upgrade, which could significantly improve Ethereum's efficiency and competitiveness? Recently, he has been focusing on Ethereum's long-term resilience and privacy needs ? Buterin has shifted his focus from scaling to protocol hardening and decentralized acceleration (d/acc) technology. He aims to achieve single-slot finality, statelessness, and virtual machine longevity. Buterin has also proposed a Layer-Zero upgrade, which could significantly improve Ethereum's efficiency and competitiveness? This upgrade would transition from the current Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) to a more efficient zVM system, reducing computational cycles and increasing throughput. Additionally, Buterin has emphasized the importance of secrecy in block proposals and has proposed solutions such as Single Secret Leader Election (SSLE) protocols 3 His efforts aim to enhance Ethereum's security, scalability, and usability, ensuring its continued dominance in the blockchain space. #price #eth #ethereum #crypto #buterin #vitalikbuterin #prediction

caption: I refuse to spend money on these things and it’s saved me £1000s - 10 rules I live by: 1. I live by buy it nice or buy it twice. Wasting money on poor quality is my pet peeve. I buy 90% of my clothing in the sale but when I buy something, I make sure it’s good quality and natural materials where it makes sense.  2. Walking - I live in central London and try to walk wherever I can. Transport adds up so quickly and you won’t see me catching the tube for 2 stops anytime soon. 3. UPF. It’s literally wasting money. You eat way more nutritious food, which saves you healthcare costs long term. And whole foods are cheaper than processed anyway. 4. Premium when basic does the job. I don't need the upgraded phone every year. I don't need first class on a 1 hour flight. I spend where it actually improves my life and cut everywhere else. 5. Trends that expire in 6 months. Fast fashion, viral gadgets, aesthetic home pieces that won't age well. If I won't want it in 2 years, I don't want it now. 6. Gifts that put me in debt. I love giving but I set a budget and stick to it. I use sinking funds every month to save for birthdays and christmas presents when the time comes. This way I avoid risking going into unnecessary credit card debt.  7. I’ll walk 5 mins to pick up my pizza instead of paying £4 to have it delivered. Delivery charges, ATM fees, last-minute bookings. A little planning saves hundreds over a year without even noticing. 8. Alcohol. I stopped drinking 2 months ago and it has already saved me £100s. The money I used to spend on nights out now goes straight into my ISA. 9. Unused memberships and subscriptions. I review my subscriptions once a month. I never have more than one entertainment subscription running at a time (Netflix, Disney, NowTV, AppleTV). Small leaks sink big ships. If it's not adding value this month, it's cancelled this month. 10. Trying to "look" wealthy. The fastest way to stay broke is spending money to impress people. I'd rather be quietly building than loudly spending. #personalfinance #spendingmoney #LearnOnTikTok #beginnerfinancetips #wealthbuilding
